title: Do not identify a floating implementation with the precision theorem
statement: The source retains B_j=alpha_jI+Q D_j Q*,building Q from actual update vectors with at most2directions per correction. Reduced solves/model applications,source/full-vector work and storage are charged,not a supplied inverse/subspace. The audit repaired a real finite-precision gap:upper residual enclosure>taualone does NOTimply actual defect>tau. Sufficient guards require enclosure width plus internal solve residual<=tau_out-tau_in,eta_eff,controlled product-Frobenius update errors and spectral feasibility,with a summable potential debitV_num. The corrected correction denominator uses tau_in-eta_eff and acceptance uses tau_out+eta_eff. Basis/truncation/clipping/norm errors must be enclosed;ordinary double precision does not prove those bounds. The midpoint-mixing feasibility repair has its stated extra2rhoerror. Prototype defaultmax_updates=None now matches the theorem;an explicit lifetime cap can stop a failed request and is not convergence. No complete certified finite-bit runtime implementation is claimed.
